notes: The authoring armature has 26 bones (fingers, claws and nine feather rows). The verified entity path supplies at most 16 bone matrices, so a 16-bone runtime bake is required before the mesh can use the game draw path.
The rig is authored for the verified entity 16-bone LBS path.
The Blender materials are an art target; runtime keeps entity_hand shading.
Feather bones are hierarchical rows, not 31 independent simulators.
